They can say whatever they want... I don't have the energy to argue. 
 
But listen - there was some guy sniffing around here recently. Poking around the institute building, asking everyone about Gunslinger. Maybe he was after documents, or maybe Gunslinger's stash - I don't know... 
 
Journalist. That was his name, I think. 
 
You're looking for the same thing... so I just thought you should know...
Hey, stalker - are you doing alright? What brings you out this way?

A bloodsucker, the bastard... crept up on me from behind... Ah, damn... There's a stash hidden somewhere on the factory grounds - it belongs to a stalker. n\ \nGunslinger... You heard that name? n\ \nThey say he made it to the Center of the Zone. That's why I came to check this place out.
Understood. Stay calm and take it easy... don't waste your energy.

Goddamn monsters... where did they even come from? I barely got out of there alive - and they hit me hard... 
 
You're after Gunslinger, aren't you? There was some weird guy sniffing around here recently, asking the same questions about Gunslinger. I saw him going through the institute building - documents, a stash, who knows what he wanted. 
 
Journalist, I think they called him.
Hi, one of yours sent me.

Things are a bit hectic around here right now. The Yantar scientists were supposed to receive some fancy valuable equipment a while ago. Typical egghead bullshit - something went wrong and it never arrived. They lost it somewhere near the research institute. \n \nTruth is, I don't want that thing getting where it's supposed to go. Whatever the professors are cooking up, it'll end badly. They're only good at one thing: using stalkers like us as cannon fodder.
So what do you want from me?

Bring me that device. The case should be lying around somewhere behind the main complex. 
 
We can't go there ourselves - place might be staked out. But you? You're a nobody. Nobody knows your face yet, so you're perfect for a quiet little job like this. 
 
So, we got a deal? Don't worry, the reward will be worth your while.
Messer, come in - it's Toad! A squad of military stalkers was spotted near the research institute. I have no idea what they're doing out there, but watch yourself!
Help! Somebody, please! I'm in a shack on the factory roof - get here fast!
Hm... Something is off about this place...
What can you tell me about this place?

This is the Agroprom Research Institute grounds. The institute building itself is to the southwest, and the factory to the north is its production and technical base. The buildings have been abandoned for a long time - there's nothing worth taking in there. \n \nBut lately the military has been actively searching through them for something. Whatever they're looking for, they haven't slowed up.

Strange legends float around about this place. Before the accident in '86, there was nothing out here but a lone institute building for cereal crop selection and genetics. And where the factory stands now were experimental fields. After the accident, the institute was shut down and the fields were burned. \n \nThen, for some reason, someone remembered it was here - whitewashed the building, put up a fence, threw up some barracks, and laid the foundations for the factory right where the fields used to be. Whatever they were doing in that institute, they clearly weren't short on funding.
